name: Kross Ltd
title: Kross Ltd - 544253 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +22% YoY to INR 225.4 cr with EBITDA margin 14.9%, but a ~5% steel/commodity pass-through lags one quarter, so Q1 margin pressure is flagged; capex shifts to seamless tube (~INR 100 cr FY27).

utilisation.quote: we are struggling to meet the demand which is being given to us, struggling to ramp up to meet our peak capacity

capex.quote: it is going to be approximately INR 100 crores for FY27. And for the other business, it is going to be at around INR 20 crores to INR 25 crores.

triggers.label: Extruded axle plant demand exceeds supply
triggers.quote: we are struggling to meet the demand which is being given to us, struggling to ramp up to meet our peak capacity

triggers.label: ~5% price hike to market, steel +INR 3-5/kg
triggers.quote: it is approximately 5% till the time there is settlement

triggers.label: Q1 margin pressure from pass-through lag
triggers.quote: we should see a margin pressure in Q1

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 14-15% guided
triggers.quote: between 14% to 15% margin is what we are looking at for the further quarters as well

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 22%; FY27 expected similar
triggers.quote: that is what we would be looking at for this financial year as well

guidance.quote: that is what we would be looking at for this financial year as well
between 14% to 15% margin is what we are looking at for the further quarters as well
We remain on track to increase the contribution of the tractor segment to approximately 15% of total revenue over the next two years.
revenue growth from the seamless unit will start in FY28

guidance.value: INR 100 cr seamless + INR 20-25 cr other
guidance.quote: it is going to be approximately INR 100 crores for FY27

red_flags.label: Q1 margin pressure from unrecovered commodity costs
red_flags.quote: so, we should see a margin pressure in Q1

red_flags.label: Steel mills holding only 50-60% of normal stock
red_flags.quote: what they are following is approximately 50%-60% of that only

evasions.topic: Trailer axle price increase vs. competitor
evasions.quote: if we have our way, we would love to increase it further, but things have to be sold also
It all depends on how the business continues to be doing.
